verdict.rationale: Alacritty's first-party docs describe built-in scrollback search with forward and backward keybindings, including vi-mode / and ? search. SearchStart/SearchEnd actions let users jump to the start or end of a match, which covers moving between matches. missing for 10: explicit documentation of next/previous-match navigation (e.g. n/N cycling), any evidence on search speed, independent or hands-on corroboration of search.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search my scrollback quickly and jump between matches

citations.quote: Search allows you to find anything in Alacritty's scrollback buffer. You can search forward using Ctrl Shift f (Command f on macOS) and backward using Ctrl Shift b (Command b on macOS).
In vi mode the search is bound to / for forward and ? for backward search.
The `SearchStart` and `SearchEnd` keybinding actions can be bound if you're looking for a way to jump to the start or the end of a match.
